watches.name: Legacy Maroon Golden
watches.description: Timeless gold-tone elegance for every occasion. The Classic Gold is the pinnacle of EK Watch Co.’s everyday luxury line. Gold-tone case, cream dial, and gold-plated indices — a composition that has stood the test of time. Worn from the boardroom to the terrace, it carries the quiet confidence of a well-chosen accent.

watches.name: Legacy Maroon Silver
watches.description: Architectural square case inspired by Newari craftsmanship. The Legacy Square breaks from the round — a bold architectural silhouette that stands apart in any collection. Inspired by the geometric craft of Newari architecture, its square case houses a meticulously finished dial with hour indices that echo the carved windows of Bhaktapur’s Palace Square.

watches.name: Everest Edition I
watches.description: Bold and enduring — named for the world’s highest peak. Named for the world’s highest peak, the Everest Edition I embodies endurance and ambition. Crafted with a robust stainless steel case and a minimalist mountain-range dial, this watch is built for those who set their sights high. A statement piece from the heart of Nepal.

watches.name: 1957 Postage Edition
watches.description: A tribute to Nepali heritage — the 1957 postage stamp reborn as a watch dial. The watch is assembled and customised in Nepal. Dial: Postage Stamp Material: Stainless Steel Movement: SL 68 Quartz Watch head: 25*30mm Lug width: 18mm Water resistance: 50M Warranty: 1 year on mechanism.
